claims.claim: AbridgeKV with one quarter of the generated cache matches an identically trained full-KV model in accuracy and output length on 446 competition problems.
claims.episode_span: On 446 problems from AIME, HMMT, AMC and similar contests with 32K-token generations, keeping one quarter of the cache matches an identically trained full-KV model in both accuracy and output length.
claims.source_title: AbridgeKV: Compressing Long Reasoning into the KV Cache of Learned Pause Tokens
claims.supporting_quote: On 446 competition problems from AIME, HMMT, AMC, BRUMO, CMIMC and SMT with 32K-token generations, keeping a quarter of the generated cache matches an identically trained full-KV model in accuracy and output length.

claims.claim: AbridgeKV served in vLLM makes the cache 3.5 times smaller per sequence and finishes problems 3.2 times faster on a saturated H100 than with full KV.
claims.episode_span: Served in vLLM the cache becomes 3.5 times smaller per sequence and a saturated H100 finishes problems 3.2 times faster than with full KV.
claims.source_title: AbridgeKV: Compressing Long Reasoning into the KV Cache of Learned Pause Tokens
claims.supporting_quote: Served in vLLM, the cache is 3.5x smaller per sequence and a saturated H100 finishes a problem 3.2x faster than with full KV.

claims.claim: MeddeX records ROUGE-1 +9.2 percent, ROUGE-2 +10.0 percent, ROUGE-L +11.8 percent, BLEU +71.4 percent and BERTScore +0.8 percent over the base LLaMA3-Med42-8B model.
claims.episode_span: Against the base LLaMA3-Med42-8B it records ROUGE-1 +9.2 percent, ROUGE-2 +10.0 percent, ROUGE-L +11.8 percent, BLEU +71.4 percent and BERTScore +0.8 percent.
claims.source_title: MeddeX: A Retrieval-Augmented LLaMA-3 System with Gemini Vision for Evidence-Backed Medical Report Analysis
claims.supporting_quote: Evaluation against the base LLaMA3-Med42-8B model demonstrates consistent improvements across ROUGE-1 (+9.2%), ROUGE-2 (+10.0%), ROUGE-L (+11.8%), BLEU (+71.4%), and BERTScore (+0.8%).

claims.supporting_quote: First, the two systems are statistically indistinguishable on the metric this task is conventionally scored by, a paired difference of -0.56 points, Jev minus Astra, at a 187-fold cost difference.
